status.main_product: Unmanned aerial systems and defense technology solutions
status.scope_reason: The company provides comprehensive enterprise drone services, including aerial mapping, surveying, and infrastructure inspections, alongside its manufacturing capabilities.
status.evidence: According to a press release reported by Economic Times, IG Drones officially rebranded as IG Defence to transition from enterprise drone services into full-spectrum military technology.

claims.claim: The company reported selling more than 200 drones in FY25, representing a 300 percent increase over FY24, and expanded its manufacturing capacity to 1,000 drones per year with plans to reach 2,500 in FY26.

The company reports the development and deployment of Skyhawk, an indigenously developed 5G-enabled hybrid VTOL drone featuring a 10kg payload capacity and satellite operational capability for defense, surveillance, and mapping tasks.
The company reports it has secured intellectual property rights by being granted a patent for India's first indigenous defence drone simulator platform.

The company reports offering commercial drone services that include GIS surveying, topography surveys, industrial data inspection, drone mapping, 3D modeling, powerline monitoring, smart city surveys, road inspection, mines surveying, flood assessment, asset monitoring, solar thermal inspection, surveillance, and crop health monitoring.

The company reports providing cross-industry services across more than 500 projects, alongside proprietary software platforms such as its DaaS (Drone-as-a-Service) IG One on-demand model and its SaaS data analytics platform.
claims.note: The cross-industry service metric of "more than 500 projects" is unconfirmed in available published sources.

claims.claim: The company reports utilizing its indigenously developed proprietary software, IG One, to process drone-captured data and provide technical insights and analytics for large-scale infrastructure monitoring contracts, including an annual contract for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Project secured in March 2023.

The company reports deploying its proprietary IG One software platform to process data and deliver comprehensive analytics and real-time project tracking for the Uttarakhand Metro Rail Project survey contract, announced in January 2024.
The company reports that its indigenously developed Skyhawk 5G VTOL drone platform is built as a Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) ready system featuring continuous 5G network connectivity.

The company reports that it has partnered with the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to set up drone Centres of Excellence across 50 engineering colleges in India to provide drone technology education, skilling, and certifications.

The Indian Army awarded a contract to IG Drones in January 2025 for the supply of domestically developed Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) and First-Person View (FPV) drones to support high-altitude and border surveillance operations.

IG Drones secured a multi-year partnership with NMDC Limited in May 2024 to conduct comprehensive drone surveying using Photogrammetry and LiDAR technologies across three financial years at the Panna Diamond Mining Project.
claims.source: Economic Times article: 'IG Drones secures work order to conduct drone survey at NMDC Diamond Mining Project, Panna'

claims.claim: The company reported a 330% year-on-year revenue growth in FY25, reaching ₹22.4 crore compared to ₹5.17 crore in FY24.
claims.source: SMEStreet and BW Businessworld articles covering IG Drones FY25 financial results.

claims.claim: The company (repositioned as IG Defence) raised $5 million in an ongoing Pre-Series A funding round in March 2026, following a $1 million seed round in October 2024.
claims.source: Inc42 profile and raising.fi reports tracking IG Defence's $5 million Pre-Series A funding in March 2026 and $1 million Seed round in September/October 2024.

claims.claim: The company has established a pan-India corporate and manufacturing footprint with active facilities, operations, or approved projects spanning Noida, Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh, and Ganjam district in Odisha.
claims.source: Janes Defence Weekly and LinkedIn official updates from IG Defence detailing manufacturing sites in Noida, Jhansi, and Ganjam district.

claims.claim: IG Drones announced a strategic collaboration with Belgian deep tech pioneer VoxelSensors in June 2025 to integrate its Single Photon Active Event Sensor (SPAES) 3D perception technology into IG Drones' UAV platforms.
claims.source: Official press release from VoxelSensors and India Technology News covering the June 2025 strategic partnership.

claims.claim: IG Drones formed a strategic alliance with Korean geospatial information-based drone solution specialist iGiS at the GITEX Global event in October 2023 to collaborate on market expansion and share operational office space.
claims.source: Business Standard and Livemint reports on the IG Drones and iGiS strategic partnership MoU signed at GITEX Global in Dubai.

claims.claim: The company reported expanding its workforce from 2 people to over 200 people.
claims.note: The detail about expanding its workforce specifically from 2 people to over 200 people could not be confirmed in public filings, company career portals, or official news releases, though LinkedIn lists its company size bracket as 201-500 employees.
claims.source: IG Defence LinkedIn company overview, official corporate careers site, and tech database registries.

status.main_product: Civil engineering surveying, mapping, and GIS consultancy services
status.scope_reason: The company provides commercial drone services such as aerial imaging, topographic mapping, and infrastructure inspections under its own name as one of its service lines.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records on ZaubaCorp, the company remains active, and its official website details its delivery of drone-based surveying and mapping services.

claims.claim: The company reports offering professional UAV-based surveying, 3D mapping, and geospatial consulting, listing drone capabilities specifically under its "UAV Drone Survey" service portfolio.
The company reports employing UAV drone mapping alongside 3D LiDAR surveys and GIS analytics to support large-scale infrastructure projects, rail corridors, and mine surveys with volume estimation.

The company reports integrating advanced GIS software, 3D terrain modeling tools, and engineering platforms like AutoCAD Civil 3D and InfraWorks to deliver outputs such as volumetric calculations, DEM/DTM generation, and agricultural NDVI crop health monitoring.

The company reports that it is a DGCA-certified drone mapping company providing UAV drone surveying and data collection using RGB, LiDAR, thermal, and multispectral sensors. imaGIS Engineering Solutions Pvt Ltd.

Public e-procurement records indicate that the company has participated in 22 government tenders as a contractor, which includes a project awarded by the CPWD in July 2026 for the preparation of a digitalized site survey plan for the NADT Campus in Nagpur.
claims.corrected: Public e-procurement records indicate that the company has participated in over 240 government tenders as a contractor, which includes a project awarded by the CPWD in July 2026 for the preparation of a digitalized site survey plan for the NADT Campus in Nagpur.

claims.claim: The company reported total revenue of ₹5.87 Cr for FY 2024, down 31.00% year-over-year.
claims.note: total revenue figures and YoY change percentage for FY 2024

claims.claim: Financial filings for the company indicate a total revenue decline of 30.64% alongside a net profit increase of 52.19% for its broader business operations.
claims.note: total revenue decline and net profit increase percentages

claims.claim: The company reports completing 500+ projects across 20+ Indian states and 10+ countries.
Aerizone Creative Labs completed a drone-based aerial mapping project for a 1300-hectare catchment area at Dina Dam where imaGIS Engineering Solutions Pvt. Ltd. acted as the client.
The company reports a workforce composed of three technocrats and a team of 60 engineers and surveyors experienced in using drone and LiDAR-based equipment.
claims.source: imaGIS Engineering Solutions Official Website About Us page (imagis.co.in)
